After the Fall Undergraduate Research Conference, each team turns its poster into a product: one decision-maker, one decision, and a working product, built with Claude, that helps them make it: a dashboard, a decision tool, a small web app or another format the team chooses, at a link anyone can open. The method is **The Launch Sprint**, design thinking with a deadline: understand one decision-maker, sketch, decide, build a realistic prototype, test it with real users, then launch. Full instructions, rubrics, templates and videos are on **Brightspace** (the Poster-to-Product module).

## Demo Days

Half of the teams in each section present on **Wed Dec 9** and half on **Fri Dec 11**, in a randomly drawn order (seed 474). Each slot is 6 minutes: a **5-minute presentation built around a live demo** of your product, making the case for what it adds for your decision-maker, then a 1-minute switch-over while the audience submits its review. Presentations stop at 5:00. Times are minutes after class starts. On Fri Dec 11, after the last team, we close the sprint in class: **Project Reflection 4 first, then the peer evaluation**, both due at 11:59 PM. Come to both days: you review every other team in your section (**I6**), and your classmates' reviews count toward each team's Demo Day grade. The review link and QR code appear on the screen in class.

## The Launch Award

- Industry professionals and alumni review every team's product from home, Dec 8–11, with the judging rubric you already have.
- Teams are ranked within each section on the judges' average product rating. Every member of the **top 3 teams in each section** gets **+5% on the final course grade**.
- Ties are broken by *Decision usefulness*, then *Evidence and honesty*, then *Clarity and ease of use*; teams still tied all win.
- To be eligible, submit a complete Launch Package on time and present on your Demo Day.
- The award is separate from your grade: the judges never see your grades, and your grades never use the judges' scores. Winners are announced by **Mon Dec 14**.
